sentences.en: The new milk commercial is an attack on human psychology.
sentences.zh: 这则新的牛奶广告是在攻击人类的心理。

sentences.en: That reverse psychology tactic isn't going to work with me.
sentences.zh: 那种反其道而行的心理战术对我不管用。

sentences.en: The more I studied psychology, the more interesting I found it.
sentences.zh: 我越是学习心理学，就越觉得它有趣。
